fullCourseName: Introduction to Mobile Robotics @ Metropolia, 2 ECTS
shortDescription: Learn Python and mobile robotics in simulation and validate key behaviours on a real ESP32 line-following robot.
fullDescription: A 2 ECTS introductory course in Python and mobile robotics. Students begin with both the browser simulator and a real robot, then develop motor, encoder, sensor, debugging, and line-following skills. Deterministic programming exercises run in simulation; selected milestones and the final adaptive line-following challenge are validated on physical hardware.
requirements: No previous programming or robotics knowledge is required.
